title: Within-person networks of clinical features of social anxiety disorder during cognitive and interpersonal therapy
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Sample size at the borderline for mlVAR analysis; - Limited power for between-person network; - Centrality measures may not fully capture dynamic processes; - Time lag of half-week may be too long for some SAD processes.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data are declared available in the supplementary materials.
